items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I don't know; he was recommended to me, and I was so sorry. I had to send him back.

ctx.x: I don't know; he was recommended to me, and I was so sorry. I had to send him back. Everybody had trouble with him. Benny Goodman had him too for a while
He wouldn't have lasted very long with Benny Goodman.
